High-cetane diesel can first be obtained by mixing [[reformate|Reformate]] and [[diesel|Diesel]]. It is used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]] source. It may also be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[desulfurized naphtha|Desulfurized Naphtha]] or [[desulfurized light oil|Desulfurized Light Oil]].
